title: Seed-Prover 1.5: Mastering Undergraduate-Level Theorem Proving via Learning from Experience
paper_type_zh: 形式化证明 Agent 模型报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 研究工具调用 RL、形式化经验轨迹、proof sketch、长程 TTS 与基准审计的读者
one_line: Seed-Prover 1.5 turns Lean, Mathlib search, Python calls, cached lemmas, and failure summaries into outcome-rewarded trajectories, then adds rubric-trained NL-to-Lean sketches and recursive proof search; 11 Putnam 2025 proofs are open, but training experience is not.
Seed-Prover 1.5 将 Lean、Mathlib 搜索、Python 调用、缓存 lemma 与失败摘要组织为终止奖励的 agent 轨迹，再以 Rubric RL 的 NL-to-Lean sketch 和递归证明树扩展推理；公开的 11 个 Putnam 2025 证明并不等于训练经验数据发布。
why: It concretizes tool-use theorem-agent experience and natural-language-to-formal decomposition while showing why final Lean validity cannot settle contamination, judge-shaped decomposition, formalization fidelity, tool dependence, or compute comparability.
inclusion_reason: A frontier disclosure of theorem-agent data as interleaved Lean/search/Python experience, summary-conditioned curriculum, outcome-only RL, rubric-trained NL-to-Lean decomposition, and compute-scaled proof trees.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-horizon Lean theorem proving requires an agent to decide when to reason, compile code, search Mathlib, run Python, cache a proved lemma, summarize failure, or restart. Seed-Prover 1.5 studies how these environment interactions can become outcome-rewarded experience and how natural-language proofs can be converted into recursive formal proof trees.

The audit problem is that “learning from experience” describes a data object but not an open dataset. The report exposes fields, tools, rewards, filters, and inference budgets, while withholding the SFT/RL trajectories, failed summaries, model weights, LooKeng, search index, Python sandbox, and orchestration.

长程 Lean 定理证明要求 agent 动态决定何时推理、编译代码、搜索 Mathlib、运行 Python、缓存已证 lemma、总结失败或重新开始。Seed-Prover 1.5 研究如何把这些环境交互变成终止奖励的经验，以及如何将自然语言证明转换为递归形式证明树。

审计上的关键是：“learning from experience”描述了数据对象，却不是开放数据集。论文披露字段、工具、奖励、过滤和推理预算，但没有发布 SFT/RL 轨迹、失败摘要、模型权重、LooKeng、搜索索引、Python sandbox 或调度系统。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core data object is an interleaved agent episode: formal prompt, optional natural-language proof or previous-failure summary, reasoning, Lean/search/Python calls, real tool responses, evolving context, cached verified lemmas, summary/restart state, final theorem, and terminal +1/-1. No step reward is claimed.

A second object is a lemma-style Lean sketch derived from a natural-language proof. It is trained by a mixed Sketch Rubric contract—Lean structure, natural-language atomic-lemma verification, and a Long-CoT rubric—and then expanded into recursively verified leaves at test time.

核心数据对象是一条交错 agent episode：形式命题、可选自然语言证明或前次失败摘要、推理、Lean/搜索/Python 调用、真实工具响应、演化上下文、缓存已证 lemma、摘要/重启状态、最终 theorem 和终止 +1/-1。论文没有声称使用 step reward。

第二类对象是由自然语言证明转换的 lemma-style Lean sketch。它通过混合 Sketch Rubric 契约训练——Lean 结构检查、自然语言原子 lemma 验证和 Long-CoT rubric——再在测试时递归展开为经验证的叶节点。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosed construction and use pipeline is:

  1. Sources and cold start. Unreleased in-house synthetic SFT data teaches Seed-Prover 1.0 tool syntax and interaction. RL mixes Big-Math, NuminaMath, CriticLean, Kimina-Prover Preview, Lean Workbook, and undisclosed in-house textbook formalizations including Graduate Texts in Mathematics.
  2. Curriculum filter. Evaluate the SFT policy at Pass@4×8. Remove tasks solved more than three times and tasks never solved under any prompt. If a failed-trajectory summary enables a solve while a direct prompt does not, retain the task under the direct prompt. Counts and parent mappings are unavailable.
  3. Agent experience. A formal prompt, optional natural-language proof or previous-failure summary enters a multi-turn policy. The policy emits reasoning and calls Lean/LooKeng, Mathlib semantic search, or Python; tool responses update context. Verified lemmas are cached with dependencies. On budget exhaustion, the agent writes a summary and can restart; a final Lean-verified theorem receives +1, otherwise -1.
  4. Environment and RL. Each direct trajectory has 64K tokens and at most 28 tool calls. Search is fixed to Mathlib v4.22.0; evaluation uses Lean v4.22.0. VAPO with ReTool-like tool-integrated PPO uses only terminal outcome reward. SFT/RL records, tool environments, reward code, optimizer details, and failed experiences are closed.
  5. Sketch Rubric RL. A Doubao-Seed-1.6-initialized natural-language prover writes a proof; a sketch model converts it to at least three Lean lemma statements admitted with sorry and transparent main-proof assembly. Lean supplies structural score S_FL; an undisclosed natural-language verifier rejects invalid atomic lemmas; an undisclosed Long-CoT LLM rubric judges alignment, decomposition, difficulty reduction, lemma value/utilization, and junk values to form S_NL. Reward is +1 iff lemma count is at least 3, S_FL≥0, and S_NL≥0.7; otherwise -1.
  6. Hierarchical TTS. The Lean agent proves or disproves each sketch leaf at Pass@3×3. Failed leaves are recursively decomposed; disproved leaves trigger sketch revision. A tree succeeds only when every leaf verifies. Putnam starts at depth 4 and can restart with cached lemmas for effective depth 8.
  7. Compute scale. Agent-only light inference uses Pass@8×8. Full Putnam/FATE/Combi evaluation allows up to 10 H20-days per problem; IMO 2025 uses roughly 20; Putnam 2025 allows up to 40 H20-days per problem. Total tokens, calls, branch counts, parallel width, and utilization remain unknown.

已披露的构造与使用流程如下：

  1. 来源与 cold start。 未发布的内部合成 SFT 数据在 Seed-Prover 1.0 基础上教授工具语法与交互。RL 混合 Big-Math、NuminaMath、CriticLean、Kimina-Prover Preview、Lean Workbook 及包含 Graduate Texts in Mathematics 的内部教材形式化。
  2. 课程过滤。 用 SFT 策略执行 Pass@4×8；删除成功超过三次的题目和所有提示都无法解决的题目。若失败轨迹摘要能解而直接提示不能解，则以直接提示保留。数量与父子映射未公开。
  3. Agent 经验。 形式命题及可选自然语言证明/失败摘要进入多轮策略。模型生成推理并调用 Lean/LooKeng、Mathlib 语义搜索或 Python；工具响应更新上下文，已证 lemma 连同依赖被缓存。预算耗尽时生成摘要并可重启；最终 theorem 经 Lean 验证得 +1，否则 -1。
  4. 环境与 RL。 单条直接轨迹上限为 64K token、28 次工具调用。搜索固定到 Mathlib v4.22.0，评测使用 Lean v4.22.0。VAPO 结合 ReTool 式工具 PPO，仅使用终止结果奖励。SFT/RL 记录、工具环境、奖励代码、优化器细节和失败经验未发布。
  5. Sketch Rubric RL。 基于 Doubao-Seed-1.6 的自然语言 prover 先写证明；sketch 模型将其转为至少三个以 sorry 占位的 Lean lemma 和透明主证明拼装。Lean 给出结构分 S_FL；未披露自然语言 verifier 排除错误原子 lemma；未披露 Long-CoT LLM rubric 评价策略对齐、分解、难度降低、lemma 价值/利用率和 junk value，形成 S_NL。仅当 lemma 数≥3、S_FL≥0、S_NL≥0.7 时奖励 +1，否则 -1。
  6. 分层 TTS。 Lean agent 以 Pass@3×3 证明或反证每个叶子；失败叶子递归分解，反证叶子触发 sketch 修订。所有叶子验证后整棵树才成功。Putnam 从 depth 4 开始，可带缓存 lemma 重启到有效 depth 8。
  7. 算力规模。 Agent-only light 使用 Pass@8×8。完整 Putnam/FATE/Combi 每题最多 10 H20-days；IMO 2025 约 20；Putnam 2025 每题最多 40 H20-days。总 token、调用、分支数、并行宽度和利用率未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Agent-only light Pass@8×8 reports 359/660 PutnamBench, 57/100 FATE-H, and 10/100 FATE-X. The full workflow at up to 10 H20-days/problem reports 580/660 PutnamBench, 80/100 FATE-H, 33/100 FATE-X, and 48/100 CombiBench; the paper itself notes substantial CombiBench formalization issues.

Putnam-200 is used to monitor roughly 1,200 RL steps and select step 1,055, after which the paper reports the full 660-item PutnamBench, apparently containing that subset. The 580/660 result is therefore partly checkpoint-selection adapted rather than a pristine untouched test estimate. No Putnam/FATE membership decontamination is disclosed.

For Putnam 2025, up to 40 H20-days/problem yields 11/12 within nine wall-clock hours. The official zip contains 11 non-A5 solutions, pins Lean/Mathlib 4.22.0, and has no textual sorry, admit, axiom, or native_decide in solution files; source was not independently compiled. VerifyStmt.lean checks declaration-type equality against a separately encoded statement, not equivalence to the English problem.

Agent-only light Pass@8×8 报告 PutnamBench 359/660、FATE-H 57/100、FATE-X 10/100。完整流程在每题最多 10 H20-days 下报告 PutnamBench 580/660、FATE-H 80/100、FATE-X 33/100、CombiBench 48/100；论文自己指出 CombiBench 存在显著形式化问题。

Putnam-200 被用于监控约 1,200 个 RL step 并选择 step 1,055，随后论文又报告显然包含该子集的完整 660 题 PutnamBench。因此 580/660 部分适配了 checkpoint 选择，并非完全未触碰的测试估计。论文没有披露 Putnam/FATE 成员级去污染。

Putnam 2025 每题最多使用 40 H20-days，在九个墙钟小时内得到 11/12。官方 zip 含除 A5 外的 11 个解答，固定 Lean/Mathlib 4.22.0，解答文件中未发现文本形式的 sorry、admit、axiom 或 native_decide；本次未独立编译。VerifyStmt.lean 仅检查解答声明与另行编码 statement 的类型相等，不验证其与英文题意等价。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Seed-Prover 1.5 makes theorem-agent “experience” concrete as a tool-interleaved trajectory rather than only a final proof or scalar reward. Its summary-conditioned restart and cached-lemma context connect failed attempts to future policy inputs, while agentic choice of Lean, retrieval, and Python interaction moves beyond a fixed proof-generation loop.

The NL-proof-to-Lean-sketch bridge also separates decomposition from leaf proving and supports recursive proof-tree scaling. This is operationally novel, but it blends formal and learned judgments during sketch training and relies on a strong natural-language prior before formal verification.

Seed-Prover 1.5 将定理 agent 的“经验”具体化为工具交错轨迹，而不只是最终证明或标量奖励。失败摘要重启和缓存 lemma 上下文把失败尝试连接到后续策略输入；agent 动态选择 Lean、检索和 Python，也超越固定证明生成循环。

自然语言证明到 Lean sketch 的桥接把分解与叶节点证明分开，并支持递归证明树扩展。该设计具有实操新意，但 sketch 训练混合了形式与学习式判断，且在形式验证前依赖强自然语言先验。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Training and failure trajectories are not released: no cold-start records, tool calls/responses, summaries, cached-lemma dependencies, reward records, rubric outputs, failed proof trees, weights, LooKeng, search index, Python sandbox, or orchestration. Outcome-only +1/-1 gives no disclosed process credit, and learned sketch judges introduce calibration and correlation risk.

Benchmark cleanliness is unresolved. Putnam-200 monitors 1,200 steps and selects checkpoint 1,055 before full PutnamBench reporting, creating selection adaptation. No decontamination covers public/in-house textbook formalizations against PutnamBench or FATE; assertions of no 2025 leakage lack source and cutoff ledgers. FATE is retrieval-sensitive, and acknowledged CombiBench and Erdős mis-formalizations show that Lean validity does not ensure English-statement fidelity.

Compute comparisons are incomplete despite useful caps: 64K/28 calls, Pass@8×8, leaf Pass@3×3, depth 4→8, 10 H20-days/problem, and up to 40 for Putnam 2025. Total tokens, calls, branches, parallel width, utilization, timeouts, and failed-tree counts are absent. The official 11-proof zip is successful evaluation output, not training or failure data, and VerifyStmt performs only type equality.

训练与失败轨迹均未发布：没有 cold-start 记录、工具调用/响应、摘要、缓存 lemma 依赖、奖励记录、rubric 输出、失败证明树、权重、LooKeng、搜索索引、Python sandbox 或调度器。终止 +1/-1 没有披露过程 credit，学习式 sketch judge 还带来校准与相关误差风险。

基准洁净性未解决。Putnam-200 监控 1,200 个 step 并选择 checkpoint 1,055，之后再报告完整 PutnamBench，形成 selection adaptation。没有去污染覆盖公开/内部教材形式化与 PutnamBench、FATE；“2025 无泄漏”也缺少来源和 cutoff 账本。FATE 强依赖检索，CombiBench 和 Erdős 已承认的错形式化说明 Lean 有效不保证英文语义忠实。

尽管披露了 64K/28 calls、Pass@8×8、叶子 Pass@3×3、depth 4→8、每题 10 H20-days 及 Putnam 2025 最多 40 H20-days，算力比较仍缺总 token、调用、分支、并行宽度、利用率、超时和失败树数。官方 11 题 zip 是成功评测输出，不是训练或失败数据；VerifyStmt 也仅做类型相等检查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
The paper provides a useful schema for agent-training data: retain prompt provenance, reasoning, ordered calls and responses, environment snapshots, verified lemma dependencies, summary/restart lineage, terminal proof, and reward. Such records would support outcome RL, tool-policy analysis, failure mining, and controlled curriculum construction.

It also suggests evaluation reporting that separates agent-only Pass@8×8 from NL-prover-plus-sketch TTS and records depth, leaf budget, H20-days, wall time, width, and retrieval snapshot. For trustworthy reuse, dataset builders should add source membership, parent IDs, English-to-Lean review, judge calibration, and a held-out model-selection protocol.

论文提供了实用的 agent 训练数据 schema：保留提示来源、推理、顺序调用与响应、环境快照、已证 lemma 依赖、摘要/重启 lineage、最终证明和奖励。这类记录可支持 outcome RL、工具策略分析、失败挖掘与受控课程构造。

它也提示评测应分开报告 agent-only Pass@8×8 与“自然语言 prover + sketch TTS”，并记录深度、叶子预算、H20-days、墙钟时间、宽度和检索快照。若要可信复用，数据构造者还需加入来源成员表、父样本 ID、英文到 Lean 审查、judge 校准和独立 model-selection 协议。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read “experience” as formal prompt → reasoning → Lean/search/Python calls → responses → cached lemmas → summary/restart → terminal +1/-1; the records themselves are not released.
  • Keep Sketch Rubric mixed: Lean structure, an undisclosed natural-language lemma verifier, and a Long-CoT rubric; +1 requires ≥3 lemmas, S_FL≥0, and S_NL≥0.7.
  • Bind agent results to 64K/28 calls and Pass@8×8; bind leaves to Pass@3×3 and Putnam recursion to depth 4→8.
  • Record compute ceilings: 10 H20-days/problem for full Putnam/FATE/Combi and up to 40 H20-days/problem for Putnam 2025.
  • Putnam-200 monitored 1,200 steps and selected step 1,055 before full PutnamBench reporting; no Putnam/FATE decontamination is provided.
  • The official zip has 11 successful Lean/Mathlib 4.22.0 proofs; VerifyStmt checks type equality only, and no training or failed trajectories are open.

• “经验”应读作形式提示→推理→Lean/搜索/Python 调用→响应→缓存 lemma→摘要/重启→终止 +1/-1；这些记录本身未发布。
  • Sketch Rubric 是混合契约：Lean 结构、未披露自然语言 lemma verifier 与 Long-CoT rubric；+1 要求≥3 个 lemma、S_FL≥0、S_NL≥0.7。
  • Agent 结果绑定 64K/28 calls 与 Pass@8×8；叶子绑定 Pass@3×3，Putnam 递归绑定 depth 4→8。
  • 记录算力上限：完整 Putnam/FATE/Combi 每题 10 H20-days，Putnam 2025 每题最多 40 H20-days。
  • Putnam-200 监控 1,200 个 step 并选择 step 1,055 后才报告完整 PutnamBench；没有 Putnam/FATE 去污染。
  • 官方 zip 含 11 个 Lean/Mathlib 4.22.0 成功证明；VerifyStmt 仅检查类型相等，训练与失败轨迹均未开放。

value_zh.html: 直接 episode 在已验证最终定理或耗尽 64K/28 次调用时停止。摘要条件化的 Pass@k×m 可以重启。分层 TTS 给每个叶节点 Pass@3×3，递归分解失败叶节点，在证伪叶节点后修订草图，并仅当所有叶节点验证通过时成功。Putnam 从深度 4 开始，可用缓存引理重启以达到有效深度 8。

value.html: Doubao-Seedprover-1.5 is post-trained from Seed-Prover 1.0; size, architecture, checkpoint hash, pretraining data, and weights are undisclosed. The natural-language prover starts from Doubao-Seed-1.6; sketch-model identity and weights are unknown.

value_zh.html: Doubao-Seedprover-1.5 从 Seed-Prover 1.0 后训练；规模、架构、checkpoint 哈希、预训练数据与权重未披露。自然语言证明器从 Doubao-Seed-1.6 起步；草图模型身份与权重未知。

value.html: Cold-start generator is unknown. Public formalizations and in-house textbook formalizers provide statements. A Doubao-Seed-1.6-derived prover provides natural-language priors and atomic-lemma judgments; an undisclosed Long-CoT LLM supplies rubric judgments; Lean supplies final correctness.

value_zh.html: 冷启动生成器未知。公开形式化与内部教材形式化器提供陈述。由 Doubao-Seed-1.6 派生的证明器提供自然语言先验与原子引理判定；未披露的 Long-CoT LLM 提供评分标准判定；Lean 提供最终正确性。

value.html: The agent generates tool-use rollouts and summaries. The natural-language prover generates informal proofs, the sketch model translates them into lemma-style Lean skeletons, and the agent fills leaves. Failed leaves can trigger recursive regeneration or sketch refinement. Checkpoints, temperatures, and logs are unknown.

value_zh.html: 智能体生成工具使用 rollouts 与摘要。自然语言证明器生成非形式证明，草图模型将其翻译为引理风格的 Lean 骨架，智能体填充叶节点。失败叶节点可触发递归再生成或草图精炼。Checkpoints、温度与日志未知。

value.html: RL interleaves policy tokens, tool calls, and real responses across 64K tokens and 28 calls. About 1,200 steps are plotted; step 1,055 is selected using Putnam-200. Agent evaluation uses direct Pass@8×1 and light Pass@8×8; curriculum uses Pass@4×8; each TTS leaf gets Pass@3×3.

value_zh.html: RL 在 64K tokens 与 28 次调用中交错策略 tokens、工具调用与真实响应。约 1,200 步被绘制；使用 Putnam-200 选择第 1,055 步。智能体评测使用直接 Pass@8×1 与轻量 Pass@8×8；课程使用 Pass@4×8；每个 TTS 叶节点得到 Pass@3×3。

value.html: Unknown for SFT/RL. Roughly 1,200 optimization steps are reported without batches, prompts, rollouts, failures, or total trajectories. Evaluation discloses Pass@8×8, Pass@3×3 per leaf, depth, and H20-days but not aggregate episodes.

value_zh.html: SFT/RL 未知。约报告 1,200 个优化步，而无 batches、提示、rollouts、失败或总轨迹。评测披露 Pass@8×8、每叶节点 Pass@3×3、深度与 H20-days，但未披露合计 episodes。

value.html: Unknown for SFT synthesis, RL, direct/light inference, natural-language proofs, sketches, rubric judgments, search queries, and hierarchical TTS.

value_zh.html: SFT 合成、RL、直接/轻量推断、自然语言证明、草图、评分标准判定、搜索查询与分层 TTS 均未知。

value.html: Run the SFT model at Pass@4×8; remove examples solved more than three times and those never solved under any prompting strategy. Retain summary-solvable/direct-unsolved items under the direct prompt. Sketches require at least three lemmas, S_FL≥0, and S_NL≥0.7. Counts and yields are unknown.

value_zh.html: 以 Pass@4×8 运行 SFT 模型；移除被解出超过三次的样例以及在任何提示策略下从未解出的样例。在直接提示下保留摘要可解/直接未解的条目。草图要求至少三条引理、S_FL≥0 与 S_NL≥0.7。计数与产出未知。

value.html: Each trajectory has 64K tokens and at most 28 calls. Light uses Pass@8×8. TTS gives each leaf Pass@3×3, starts at depth 4, and may restart with cached lemmas to effective depth 8. Full Putnam/FATE/Combi uses up to 10 H20-days/problem; IMO 2025 roughly 20 H20-days/problem; Putnam 2025 up to 40 H20-days/problem and 11/12 within nine wall-clock hours. Width, total tokens/calls, utilization, and branch stops are unknown.

value_zh.html: 每条轨迹有 64K tokens 且至多 28 次调用。轻量使用 Pass@8×8。TTS 给每个叶节点 Pass@3×3，从深度 4 开始，并可用缓存引理重启至有效深度 8。完整 Putnam/FATE/Combi 每题至多 10 个 H20-days；IMO 2025 每题约 20 个 H20-days；Putnam 2025 每题至多 40 个 H20-days 且 11/12 在九个墙钟小时内。宽度、总 tokens/调用、利用率与分支停止未知。

value.html: Cold-start SFT settings are undisclosed. Agentic RL uses VAPO with ReTool-like tool-integrated PPO and terminal +1/-1 reward. Sketch VAPO collapses mixed formal/judgment scores to +1/-1. Learning rates, clipping, advantage estimator, KL, batches, packing, compute, and checkpoints are unknown.

value_zh.html: 冷启动 SFT 设置未披露。智能体 RL 使用带类 ReTool 工具集成 PPO 与终态 +1/-1 奖励的 VAPO。草图 VAPO 将混合的形式化/判定分数折叠为 +1/-1。学习率、裁剪、优势估计器、KL、batches、packing、计算量与 checkpoints 未知。

value.html: Five public sources plus in-house textbooks are named, but cold-start synthetic SFT, books/editions, snapshots, counts, proportions, formalizers, and benchmark overlap are undisclosed.

value_zh.html: 点名了五个公开来源外加内部教材，但冷启动合成 SFT、书籍/版本、快照、计数、比例、形式化器与基准重叠未披露。

value.html: No immutable split is released. Putnam-200 monitors about 1,200 RL steps and selects step 1,055, after which full 660-item PutnamBench—apparently including that subset—is reported. FATE/Combi exclusions are undocumented; 2025 no-leak claims lack cutoffs.

value_zh.html: 未发布不可变划分。Putnam-200 监测约 1,200 个 RL 步并选择第 1,055 步，此后报告完整 660 条的 PutnamBench——显然包括该子集。FATE/Combi 排除未记录；2025 无泄漏声称缺乏截止。

value.html: No statement, proof, textbook, repository, semantic, or trajectory decontamination is disclosed. Public/formalized textbook data may overlap Putnam/FATE. Putnam-200 checkpoint selection creates evaluation adaptation even without training membership.

value_zh.html: 未披露陈述、证明、教材、仓库、语义或轨迹去污染。公开/已形式化教材数据可能与 Putnam/FATE 重叠。Putnam-200 checkpoint 选择即使没有训练成员关系也会造成评测适配。

items: No experience buffer, tool trajectory, failed summary, reward record, or curriculum mapping is released.
Outcome-only +1/-1 gives long failed trajectories undifferentiated credit; invalid calls, timeouts, and environment faults are unspecified.
Sketch reward depends on undisclosed learned judges and a hand-set three-lemma/0.7 threshold.
The Doubao-Seed-1.6 natural-language prior means agent-only and full-workflow scores are not interchangeable.
Cached lemmas are axiom-like context entries; dependency integrity and protection of final certificates are not fully exposed.
LooKeng, search index, Python sandbox, tool limits, and images are closed.
Difficulty filtering removes both easy and never-solved items, hiding hard-failure scale.
Putnam-200 checkpoint selection makes 580/660 on full PutnamBench partly development-set adapted.
No Putnam/FATE contamination audit exists; 2025 no-leak claims lack temporal/source evidence.
FATE depends heavily on Mathlib retrieval, and CombiBench has acknowledged formalization issues.
Mis-formalized Erdős cases show Lean verifies the encoded statement, not equivalence to the intended problem.
VerifyStmt.lean checks declaration-type equality only; it does not validate English-to-Lean semantic fidelity.
TTS budgets mix Pass@k×m, depth, H20-days, and wall time without normalized tokens, calls, width, or utilization.
未发布经验缓冲区、工具轨迹、失败摘要、奖励记录或课程映射。
仅结果的 +1/-1 给长失败轨迹无差别的信用；无效调用、超时与环境故障未指定。
草图奖励依赖于未披露的习得评审与手工设定的三引理/0.7 阈值。
Doubao-Seed-1.6 自然语言先验意味着仅智能体分数与全工作流分数不可互换。
缓存引理是类公理的上下文条目；依赖完整性与最终证书的保护未完全暴露。
LooKeng、搜索索引、Python 沙箱、工具限制与镜像是封闭的。
难度过滤同时移除简单与从未解出的条目，掩盖困难失败的规模。
Putnam-200 checkpoint 选择使完整 PutnamBench 上的 580/660 部分为开发集适配。
不存在 Putnam/FATE 污染审计；2025 无泄漏声称缺乏时间/来源证据。
FATE 严重依赖 Mathlib 检索，且 CombiBench 有已承认的形式化问题。
错误形式化的 Erdős 案例表明 Lean 验证的是编码后的陈述，而非与预期问题的等价。
VerifyStmt.lean 仅检查声明类型相等；它不验证英文到 Lean 的语义保真。
TTS 预算混合 Pass@k×m、深度、H20-days 与墙上时间，而无归一化 tokens、调用、宽度或利用率。

value.html: The Apache-2.0 repository releases the paper, 11 Putnam proofs/checks, and an Erdős file. Models, training/sketch records, textbook formalizations, trajectories, tools, and index are closed; source-level rights are unknown.

value_zh.html: Apache-2.0 仓库发布论文、11 份 Putnam 证明/检查与一份 Erdős 文件。模型、训练/草图记录、教材形式化、轨迹、工具与索引是封闭的；来源级权利未知。

value.html: Stage-level lineage runs from prompt through reasoning, calls/responses, cached lemmas, summary/restart, terminal Lean result and reward; sketch adds NL proof, skeleton, atomic judgments, rubric scores, leaves, and proof tree. Immutable record-to-checkpoint lineage is absent.

value_zh.html: 阶段级谱系从提示经推理、调用/响应、缓存引理、摘要/重启、终态 Lean 结果与奖励；草图增加 NL 证明、骨架、原子判定、评分标准分数、叶节点与证明树。不可变的记录到 checkpoint 谱系缺失。
